title: There is / there are
note: There is / are = something is here. Dummy There is the new structure (not Czech je / It is / Czech order). Locative items gap There is / Is there; others gap is/are. · classfix B/D/E-2026-07-25 · RUE2 TRANSPLANT 2026-08-25. · 2026-08-29 smoke: C12 common mistakes; B4 It is / Is / Czech order on chips.

items.en: There is a book on the table.
accepts: There is a book on the table.
There's a book on the table.
items.explanation: Not *It is* or *On the table is*. **There is** a book + place.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It is* a ne český pořádek. **There is** a book + místo.

items.en: There are two books on the table.
accepts: There are two books on the table.
items.explanation: More than one: **There are**, not *There is* or *They are*.
items.explanation_cz: Víc věcí: **There are**, ne *There is* ani *They are*.

items.en: There is a cat under the chair.
accepts: There is a cat under the chair.
There's a cat under the chair.
items.explanation: Not *It is*. **There is** a cat + place.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It is*. **There is** a cat + místo.

items.en: There are three chairs in the room.
accepts: There are three chairs in the room.
items.explanation: More than one: **There are**, not *There is* or *They are*.
items.explanation_cz: Víc věcí: **There are**, ne *There is* ani *They are*.

items.en: There is a phone in the bag.
accepts: There is a phone in the bag.
There's a phone in the bag.
There is a telephone in the bag.
items.explanation: Not *It is*. **There is** a phone + place.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It is*. **There is** a phone + místo.

items.en: There are keys on the table.
accepts: There are keys on the table.
items.explanation: **There are** keys. Plural → **are**, not *is*.
items.explanation_cz: **There are** keys. Množné → **are**, ne *is*.

items.en: There is a problem.
accepts: There is a problem.
There's a problem.
items.explanation: There is + singular noun. (*It's a problem* is a different sentence.)
items.explanation_cz: There is + jednotné podstatné jméno. (*It's a problem* je jiná věta.)

items.en: There are two problems.
accepts: There are two problems.
items.explanation: **There are** two problems. Not *There is*.
items.explanation_cz: **There are** two problems. Ne *There is*.

items.en: There is a school near here.
accepts: There is a school near here.
There's a school near here.
items.explanation: **There is** a school. One school → **is**.
items.explanation_cz: **There is** a school. Jedna škola → **is**.

items.en: There are many people here.
accepts: There are many people here.
items.explanation: **There are** many people. Plural → **are**.
items.explanation_cz: **There are** many people. Množné → **are**.

items.en: There isn't a bank here.
accepts: There isn't a bank here.
There is not a bank here.
There's not a bank here.
items.explanation: Not *It isn't*. **There isn't** a bank here.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It isn't*. **There isn't** a bank here.

items.en: There aren't any chairs.
accepts: There aren't any chairs.
There are not any chairs.
There are no chairs.
There're no chairs.
items.explanation: **There aren't** any chairs. Negative plural → **aren't**.
items.explanation_cz: **There aren't** any chairs. Zápor množné → **aren't**.

items.en: Is there a bathroom?
accepts: Is there a bathroom?
items.explanation: Question: **Is there**…? Not *Is a bathroom?* or *Is here…?*
items.explanation_cz: Otázka: **Is there**…? Ne *Is a bathroom?* ani *Is here…?*

items.en: Are there any questions?
accepts: Are there any questions?
items.explanation: Question: **Are there** any questions? Not *Is there*.
items.explanation_cz: Otázka: **Are there** any questions? Ne *Is there*.

items.en: Is there a bus to Dolni Pocernice?
accepts: Is there a bus to Dolni Pocernice?
items.explanation: Question: **Is there**…? Not *Is a bus…?* or *Is here…?*
items.explanation_cz: Otázka: **Is there**…? Ne *Is a bus…?* ani *Is here…?*

items.en: Are there two windows?
accepts: Are there two windows?
items.explanation: Question: **Are there** two windows? Not *Is there*.
items.explanation_cz: Otázka: **Are there** two windows? Ne *Is there*.

items.en: There is an apple on the table.
accepts: There is an apple on the table.
There's an apple on the table.
items.explanation: Not *It is*. **There is** an apple + place.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It is*. **There is** an apple + místo.

items.en: There is a university in the city.
accepts: There is a university in the city.
There's a university in the city.
items.explanation: Not *It is*. **There is** a university + place.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It is*. **There is** a university + místo.

items.en: There is a dog in the garden.
accepts: There is a dog in the garden.
There's a dog in the garden.
items.explanation: Not *It is*. **There is** a dog + place.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It is*. **There is** a dog + místo.

items.en: There are four people in the room.
items.gap: There ____ four people in the room.
accepts: There are four people in the room.
items.explanation: **There are** four people. Plural → **are**.
items.explanation_cz: **There are** four people. Množné → **are**.

items.en: There is a car in front of the house.
items.gap: ____ a car in front of the house.
accepts: There is a car in front of the house.
There's a car in front of the house.
items.explanation: Not *It is*. **There is** a car + place.
items.explanation_cz: Ne *It is*. **There is** a car + místo.

items.en: There are shops next to the school.
items.gap: There ____ shops next to the school.
accepts: There are shops next to the school.
items.explanation: **There are** shops. Plural → **are**.
items.explanation_cz: **There are** shops. Množné → **are**.

items.en: There is milk in the fridge.
accepts: There is milk in the fridge.
There's milk in the fridge.
items.explanation: **There is** milk. No plural → **is**.
items.explanation_cz: **There is** milk. Bez množného → **is**.

items.en: There isn't any coffee.
accepts: There isn't any coffee.
There is not any coffee.
There's not any coffee.
There is no coffee.
There's no coffee.
There is not coffee.
items.explanation: **There isn't** any coffee. Negative → **isn't**, not *aren't*.
items.explanation_cz: **There isn't** any coffee. Zápor → **isn't**, ne *aren't*.

cards.title: There is / there are
cards.title_cz: Je tu / jsou tu — něco je

examples.en: **There is** a book on the table.
**There are** two books on the table.

points: Use this to say something is here.

cards.title: There ≠ place
points: In There is…, There is NOT a place word
Place comes later: on the table, in the bag…

cards.title: is or are?
cards.title_cz: is nebo are? — podle věci ZA is/are
points: Look at the noun after is/are — not at There

examples.en: **There is** a car in front of the house.

rows: **There is** a book on the table.
*It is a cat under the chair.*
**There is** a cat under the chair.
